description: This file contains extension methods for the PdfSharp testing utility, adding functionality such as string splitting, obtaining the original location of an assembly, and chunking enumerables (conditional for pre-.NET 6.0).

classes.name: TestHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for strings, assemblies, and enumerables specific to testing helpers.

methods.name: Splitter
methods.description: Splits the input string by the specified separator into an array of substrings.

methods.name: GetOriginalLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the original file path of the given assembly, handling different runtime versions.

methods.name: Chunk
methods.description: Splits a sequence into chunks of specified maximum size (only included for .NET versions earlier than 6.0).
